avis.titre: I love this sunscreen soooo much!
avis.texte: finally the HG sunscreen I've been waiting for! I have breakout prone skin that is so sensitive, most "chemical" sunscreen tends to sting. mineral sunscreens have that white cast (and the tinted ones look bad on me). plus most sunscreens in general just feel so greasy. this sunscreen solves all of it. silky, matte, doesn't cause my skin to react in any way. I don't need to moisturize beforehand, and it makes a great primer too. I LOVE THIS. Vacation: PLEASE never stop making it!!!!

I patch tested this product about 3 times and then applied it to the bottom half of my face, and a different sunscreen to the top half of my face. Within 12 hours, I had a very painful allergic reaction that is just on my bottom half of my face. I was even more disappointed to see the reviews after this, that other people experienced the same issue. I'm still in pain from the allergic reaction and my face is still red and slightly swollen several days later. I wouldn't recommend. Bad product

this performs very well! comparable to super goop's unseen sunscreen without the pore clogging ingredients. I love that it doesn't peel under my makeup, or over my makeup if I'm out in the sun & I need to reapply! Ive been wearing this every single day for that last 3 or 4 weeks. I have very acne prone sensitive rosacea skin and it's not caused me any breakouts or flareups. I use quite a lot and I'm about halfway through the bottle.
Goes on very smoothly like silk. Great as a base for my liquid foundation. No tackiness and no scent. Awesome product!

I bought this sunscreen when Consumer Reports rated it highly. It is clear and has a good texture for using as a primer under foundation. While it says it unscented, it does have a chemical smell that dissipates quickly. I am glad when companies make a sunscreen that tests well. It doesn't bother my skin and I'm sensitive.
This sunscreen feels like silk going on. Great coverage. I will surely buy more as Summer gets going.

This is a good product, but if you start to sweat, it will burn your eyes. It does go on nicely though, not thick or oily, very smooth and thin. The consistency is nice feeling on the face, but again, if you begin to sweat, or any gets in your eyes it will sting!

avis.titre: Looking for light snd clear spf?  Done!
avis.texte: Excellent light gel and 100% white cast spf for face, neck and ears. I would use the cream spf on body.
love a clean sunscreen for my face, i have super sensitive skin and this was perfect for it!
I bought a month ago and was delivered within a week. Love the feel, smell, and coverage.

Hands down the cleanest-feeling sunscreen I've ever used! I live in Florida and have been trying to force myself to use more sunscreen - and have tried everything from Neutrogena to Supergoop. This stuff is the best!
Like it so far! Uses once and feels amazing going on and didn't irritate my skin at all.
Invisible feel and works great! Also makes skin feel softer and helps blur pores

As someone with a dryer skin type, I tend to favor butters/oils over water based gel textures, which would usually break me out. I was a bit nervous about this happening as gel based moisturizers are typically too drying, tacky and make my skin feel tight. This doesn't do that at all!!!! It goes on extremely smooth and soft. It does not feel tacky or sticky at all. Very lightweight, you completely forget you have it on. I have very sensitive/dry acne prone skin and this does not break me out. This on top of the high SPF, I will definitely be getting more.
This blends into your face so quickly and feels like nothing is on your skin.
I just received a few days ago! Have not used a lot but does smell good:
This goes on so smooth and moisturizes my skin too. Great for every day outside, the beach or the pool.
Interesting texture, a little greasy at first. Absorbs really quickly and lasts even through an ocean dip

I wore it once, and I got a horrible allergic reacion. My face and neck got all red, puffy and itchy. I made a patch test on my forearm just to make sure it was the sunscreen, and I got the same allergic reaction there.

I'm super picky about sunscreen, especially American ones. This one feels great, perfect for oily skin. It has a slight smell but it goes away quickly. It always doubles as a primer and my makeup looks great. No piling either!
I would not reccomend this sunscreen, it feels really greasy on your face and the chemical smell does not go away or get better.

This is the 2nd bottle I've bought. I wear it on days that I go without makeup…walking @ the community center or hanging around the house. Love the feel of it on my skin…it gives it a great softness while protecting my face, neck & chest from the sun.
Crystal Sunscreen is the lightest CLEAR Sunscreen out there. With a 50 SPF, it is perfect for faces every day. I can unequivocally recommend this sunscreen.

I love the aesthetics of this brand with the throwback vibes & the price of this competitor to Supergoop! Unseen. Unfortunately, this leaves a greasy feeling and a shine after applying. Hoping they reformulate with a matte finish that vanishes.

I've been using this sunscreen for the past week, and my skin loves it! Best texture and glides smoothly over my face. There's a faint scent to it, that I can't describe, but it gives me joy every morning hehe.
Goes on smooth and doesn't leave me shiny. Works well under make up too. Will definitely buy again.
I live the feel of your products and give me the protection I desire
This product does not pill over your moisturizer or when you put makeup on top. I am so pleased. Feels like silk on your skin. Very mild scent as well.

I've been looking for a sunscreen that I could wear under my CC cream. This gel goes on effortlessly and seems to provide a good primer for makeup. I love that it has absolutely no scent to it. I'm very happy with it so far!

My face became swollen within hours of using this product. I honestly thought the issue was something else I used. But I tried it again weeks later and ended up with the same problem. I had to go on steroids for 2 weeks, take antihistamines and use a hydrocortisone cream to resolve it.

I've long been looking for a face sunscreen that 1) doesn't break me out, 2) doesn't make my other skincare pill into gross little globs when applied, and 3) has a good amount of spf to protect my very pale skin. This is the first I've found that checks all those boxes, with the added benefit of being a makeup primer (I hadn't used one before and it makes a difference, and is a good reminder to apply it). Since it's clear it doesn't give you any white cast and when applied to my scalp where my hair parts it doesn't make it look greasy. Doesn't feel greasy on your skin either, it feels "matte" like a primer. No breakouts and no pilling were at the core of my sunscreen hunt, and I think the slightly higher price than the Neutrogena/CeraVe range I'd been struggling with using is well worth it since my skin didn't like those at all, and sunscreen isn't very effective if you never want to use it! I've been doing a fair amount of gardening in full sun this summer and I don't think my face has gotten tanned at all (still using the concealer shade I bought in the winter) and I certainly haven't burned. Nothing to do with how it performs, but the aesthetic retro packaging is so very cute too!

I enjoy the Vacation brand and was excited to try this product after an extensive search for a new daily sunscreen with a higher SPF than my current one. I really liked the texture and application feel, as well as the lack of scent. However, after several hours, I started developing a rash and by the time I had a chance to wash my face, my eyes were swelling shut and I had hives all over my face, in addition to the rash. I would not normally consider my skin to be "sensitive," but obviously there was something in this that didn't agree with my skin.
Lightweight, not sticky sunscreen for the win! Will buy again.
Had a nice experience with this product. Not super fragrant, and a little went a long way. Took this on a beach vacation to Florida.
This is the SPF protection I've been looking for all my life. Goes on smooth and clear. Never greasy or messy feeling. I love this product.

It really is crystal clear when applied and leaves no residue. I've been using this for a couple of weeks now and absolutely love it. It has no fragrance, which was a dislike of my previous go too. Everything makes my eyes water, and this does not! This will now be my new primer, and it's given my face great protection by the pool while still allowing a nice tan to come thru when I want it 🌞
This goes on so smoothly… most facial sunscreen, if you are out in the Sun, once you start to perspire… burns the crap out of your eyes…. This one does not!!! Highly recommend!!

I used to buy such expensive sunscreen because my skin is so sensitive. This did not bother my skin at all, the scent is faint but pleasant, and i got NO burns, just pretty color. Love. Definitely re purchasing!!

This feels like great smoothing primer, but is actually a sunscreen. Great for makeup days and makeup free days. I normally can't use American chemical sunscreens, but I have no skin irritation from this one. My only con is it burns my eyes. I use a different sunscreen for the eye area becaus of this.
This is a great SPF. It goes on clear and is water resistant. It sinks right in and is not greasy or shiny at all. It also does not sting my eyes. Definitely a favorite for swimming.

avis.titre: Nice texture, burns your eyes, doesn't work
avis.texte: I bought this along with the vacation body spray before my vacation to Greece. I loved how the product felt going on, the smooth texture is really nice. But it doesn't actually work. I use sunblock religiously to protect against hyperpigmentation and within an hour , I could see my spots getting worse. I switched back to my Korean sunblock and it protected much better. This product BURNS your eyes! I hate that about US sunblock. I had high hopes for this company since I love the whipped sunblock so much for my body but this face sunblock is not it.

I have used so many face sunscreen cringing as I put the lotion on my face! Yes, it protected well but I couldn't wait to get it off. CRYSTAL is fantastic! No exaggeration here, it feels like satin going on and I can't even feel it on my face. Best part? NO sunburn and I swim daily. I know there are similar products out there but twice the price. HIGHLY recommend this.

ive been looking for a face sunscreen that will work on top of my oil-based products, won't whitecast, and doesn't irritate my skin and this is the one! it's also very light and doesn't have the thick greasiness a lot of sunscreens have. very recommend!
Love this sunscreen. The coverage is great and it feels so silky.
I received my order a week ago, I just love it. So light a and no fragrance. A light Gel.
For those few times you don't want the Vacation scent but still a clean quality sunscreen for your face, this kills.
I used this at the pool and Vegas and love the gel texture & coverage.
i love this sunscreen. it's perfectly clear, easy to apply, doesn't smell strongly, and lays well under other products. what more can I ask for?

Was hesitant to try this as I like a tinted facial sunscreen but now, I'm A Believer! This is better: it lays down a super smooth palette for makeup or tinted products without the mess and potential for smudges on days when no such embellishment is required. Feels clean, not greasy and imparts the kind of pleasant blurriness normally delivered by a blended cocktail.
This is the best facial sunscreen I've ever used. Feels incredible, sits well under makeup, and smells like nothing. It also doesn't sting my eyes! 10/10.
Like all the Vacation products this does what it says. Fantastic brand

I didn't know that I could love anything more than I already love my Vacation sunscreen, but I was wrong! The texture of this is perfect, it's so light and doesn't feel sticky or heavy and works phenomenally!

Not sure if anyone else has commented this or not, but even though I love this sunscreen for my combo/oily/sensitive skin, it smells like pool water. I'm not sure what its supposed to smell like, but most likely would be better if it was unscented or had a very light scent.
amazing texture -- my daughter hates the way sunscreen feels but will wear this happily. I've already ordered more!
2+ hours of unerelentung burning. Tears streaming, rubbing my face so much no spf would have even survived. Pointless and painful. My eyes did not deserve this.

I really like this sunscreen so far! All facial sunscreens I've used before have been so heavy, and when I'm already sweaty, it's hard to slather on a thick layer of lotion. This stuff is lightweight, doesn't make me sweat extra, and couldn't leave a white cast if it tried.

avis.titre: Really nice SPF (and no white cast lol)
avis.texte: Bought ~month ago, really liked the marketing of Vacation lol! But the sunscreen is actually really nice and effective. It's hard to find sunscreen for brown skin that won't have you looking like Casper is your sibling. This works perfectly. Haven't tried it with makeup, but don't think it'd be too good with that since it does make youe skin feel kind of greasy/oiled? Not bad enough to feel frustrated but yea, might not play nice with other products. Could be wrong tho!
This product is amazing and i highly recommend it as its cheaper than other similar products and does not.
Had the same reaction with this stuff as I did with the spritz. Face blew up like a balloon and was red and itchy. Beware if you have sensitive skin.
Love this product! Highly recommend for summertime before the pool or under makeup every day.
This will be my go-to sunscreen from now on- works as a primer, too.

I've been waiting for clear sunscreen for the face and it's finally here thanks to Vacation! I love the clear application, that it's scentless and the spf 50. It works great under my powder foundation and helps keep my skin moisturised. I will be purchasing this again in the future.

I have only used this once so far, but I'm already in love! I wanted something similar to a matte sunscreen without the dry feeling or making me look dull and this is it. I also use La Roche Posay Cica sunscreen and can be a little thick for some days which is why I decided to try this. I wish it came in a bigger size! There is little to no scent, doesn't burn my eyes, and it layers over my moisturizer just fine (no pilling). As far as if it will cause any breakouts, I hope not, but only time will tell.

The texture is great. It dries down without a cast. But it is an absolute failure. My eyes burn so bad within an hour of application. Watering starts only a few minutes after the burning. I dont have sensitive eyes or skin, but this stuff lit me up.

Used this for the first time on vacation (haha) last week, and I will keep using it. Love the gel formula, smooth application and it does not make your skin greasy at all. Wears well as is or under a little light makeup as well.
Light as air, so comfortable and super effective. Disappears on your face - my girlfriends and I were pleasantly surprised!

avis.titre: This is the best stuff ever! Literal lifesaver!
avis.texte: I have really bad rosacea thats super picky with sunscreens and sensitive skin which causes me to be really peculiar with formulas or else i break out into pustules and bumps. I wear this all day and nothing triggers flareups! Its perfect if you want a light sunscreen without minerals but enjoy a perfect sunscreen that works with your skins barrier and doesnt feel oily, heavy and is perfect if you need something just to wear if you need it for sensitive skin, have to layer it up on skin topicals etc. I absolutely adore vacation and have been a longtime customer and this here has to be hands down my favorite product, its a lifesaver for someone who literally cannot wear any other kind of sunscreen for my face, its the perfect formula.

avis.titre: Stings eyes and not effective (for me)
avis.texte: I wanted to love this since it has great ingredients and isn't alcohol based like other clear sunscreen. I use three finger lines worth of this and it unfortunately just doesn't sink in when using that much. As I was running, it made its way into my eyes and it stings similar to other chemical spf products. I used this 3 different times to make sure, but it just doesn't work for me.

be cautious when using this sunscreen. i used it on my vacation and ended up losing a whole day to, what i think was, a terrible allergic reaction. my whole face was burning and red and my eyes swelled almost completely shut. they were burning so bad to the point i couldn't stop crying from how bad they burned. i'm not someone with sensitive skin and ive used many many many different types and brands of face sunscreens and have never had anything like that happen. be careful

I'm not sure how I discovered this SPF, but I'm SO glad I did. It's everything I've been searching for in a face SPF: SPF 50, lightweight yet moisturizing, water resistant, and doesn't irritate my eyes. I will definitely repurchase.

This is a solid product with clear application and little to no smell. The finish is a little wet/shiny though for me, and I prefer a more matte finish. I am not applying makeup over this so I want a drier matte look to my skin after applying. It's overall nice and spreads easily etc.

Loving the silky smoothness. This sunscreen glides on invisibly and works great as an everyday primer. The fact that it works double duty as sunscreen and primer is a game changer! Highly recommended!

This product is absolutely fantastic. The clear gel formula makes this easy to apply without worrying about white residue or streaks. This and the Studio Tone Bronzing Drops are without a doubt the best facial sunscreens out there!
Loved that there was no sunscreen smell or texture. Makes it easier to want to apply every day because it's a better experience than with regular sunscreen. Doesn't feel oily, goopy, or thick.

I purchased my FOURTH bottle of Vacation fragrance and was pleasantly surprised that it included a free bonus of body lotion! Vacation is my favorite (and only) fragrance. Requesting you start making it in Shower Gel please!

avis.titre: All these reviews have to be fake
avis.texte: I feel like there's a bombardment of fake reviews on here. There's no way there are this many fans of this product. It pills, it smells weird, the texture is really strange. I'm not sure what's going on with the high overall rating.
This works great as a primer - and it's a powerhouse with the high SPF!
This is my favorite face sunscreen I have ever used! It goes on so easy and it instantly dries. I would definitely buy this again. Don't ever change the formula!

Love that it's high spf and water resistant without feeling heavy or having white cast. Once it's on you hardly notice it and it reapplies nicely. It works well as a primer or on its own. I appreciate the lack of fragrance and light weight feel. It also seems to be really gentle on my skin and eyes which is surprising for a chemical sunscreen

I'm white as Elmers glue, don't tan, and turn lobster red with the slightest bit of sun. I've put this to the test twice already, doing yard work, and it's the best. Doesn't irritate skin and flare up rosacea, washes off cleanly, and keeps the sunburns away. Win win win. Thanks, Vacation! I was already a huge fan of the Vacation perfume, Shake Shake mineral sunscreen, and air fresheners, now adding this one to the list.
This stuff is amazing!! Sunscreen & primer combined, not sticky, no smell, it's excellent! Will repurchase!

Even my husband said "wow, this stuff is really good." He then asked if it came in a bigger bottle. We both have sensitive skin, and he has terrible issues with sunscreens & white cast and this gave us zero issues. Wore it for a long walk on a sunny day with zero burning.

I wear sunscreen everyday, hot or cold, rain or shine. I was excited to try this because I love the Vacation sunscreen products (they now have a body lotion to go with their perfume 😍). I just don't like the white cast on my face, which is why I've always gone with Supergoop's Unseen Sunscreen for my face. When I saw that Vacation released Crystal, I had to give it a try and compare it to Supergoop! They are literally same thing, HOWEVER… Vacation Crystal is cheaper, it goes on slightly smoother than Supergoop (Supergoop I find to be more gritty) and the consistency is not as thick as Supergoop. I love both Supergoop and Vacation but I'm sure after this Vacation Crystal will be my new go to! ❤️
This sunscreen is awesome. My skin feels and looks beautiful after application.
It goes on so smooth and leaves no residue. I love this sunscreen and it is not crazy expensive. Also, im obsessed with tje smell. It smells like vacation!!
Feels amazing on the skin. No burning! Works well under makeup.
Definitely delivers on being an invisible sunscreen in both look and feel. I appreciate it doesn't have a smell or white cast and doesn't irritate my eyes or skin. Definitely will use this often.

This sunscreen literally feels like nothing, lol. It goes on completely clear and, if anything, feels like the thinnest velvety layer on top of my skin, whether I've freshly cleansed and moisturized or later in the day. It doesn't pill and feels completely weightless, and hasn't irritated my sensitive skin or eyes. LOVE this sunscreen! Wore it everyday on my Miami trip and while I typically burn easily, I didn't get burnt whatsoever.

I have been a huge Vacation fan for years but I have to say this is their first flop! While it is light as air as advertised, it leaves a nasty filmy feeling on the fingers that leaves me trying to rub it off on something. Additionally, while advertised as "scentless" it is far from it: it smells like chlorine and pool floatie. It is like if you took all the sweet smells out of their signature scent. Hard skip on this one.
I've been looking for an spf that would go well under my makeup, I have been disappointed in the past, but because this is a silicone based one it works perfectly
Super lightweight, nice smooth finish. Works great as a makeup base, with no pilling
Cooling and refreshing plus no white residue!! I will definitely purchase again!

This exceeded my expectations. It reminded me of supergoops unseen sunscreen but it's less greasy and smells so good (supergoops petroleum smell isn't my favorite). Doesnt leave skin greasy or shiny, and my skin feels so soft
I bought this from the spring break sale and LOVE it so far. no smell on my sensitive skin and works perfectly under makeup or without, 10/10!!
There is NO reason to NOT buy this. Honestly, it's CLEAR, doesn't sting my skin or my eyes. It's SPF 50. Did I mention it's clear??

Where has this stuff been all my life? I have super sensitive skin on my face, but I had no burning sensation whatsoever when I applied the Crystal sunscreen. The texture feels amazing: velvety and not greasy at all. My pores look blurred and my skin looks good enough that I don't need to put makeup on top of the sunscreen. I also like that it's an unscented product that still has a pleasant smell to it, unlike how sometimes unscented products smell like weird chemicals. I am absolutely in love with this product, and I will be buying it again.

Prefacing this by saying that I have oily/acne prone skin; this is the best facial SPF I've ever used! My previous go-tos were supergoop & shiseido, but this one is SO much better I'm honestly in disbelief. It sinks into my skin so well I can't even tell it's there, and after wearing / reapplying all day I don't turn into an oily mess. I also don't have any issue getting it out of the bottle / it's a thinner gel consistancy. 100/10 fr.

I love the package design. But I find this product to be very greasy. I use it for exercise, and generally shower afterwards, so I dont mind. But I would be hesitant to use this product other than for working out or being at the pool or beach.
I tend to like products from this brand, but this one didn't do it for me
Love love love it! I want to buy more already for no reason lol…
" Crystal" clear is what this product is. Smooth and light, this product goes on invisibly. I couldn't be happier.

I absolutely love this face sunscreen! It's light and absorbs quickly with oily residue and it doesn't burn my eyes like all others. Usually sunscreens put any where near my eyes make them burn. Love! Love! Love this product! Everyone should try it!

I've been using the Supergoop Unseen (only because Vacation didn't have this yet), but as soon as I received this I fell in love. It has no smell and works perfectly under makeup. I wore it under my skin tint hiking this weekend and it just looked amazing. Not to mention the sun protection. I'm so glad Vacation came out with this so I can return to being an all Vacation brand snob 😆
Excellent primer with SPF protection. Make up applies easily, and smooths the skin. Very happy with the purchase.

avis.titre: Product barely comes out of bottle
avis.texte: The actual sunscreen feels nice on the skin. It's light and not greasy. But I could barely squeeze anything out. I don't know if mine was broken or what but I have to return it because I'm worried the bottle is going to explode from how hard I have to squeeze.

I have been using the Vacation Crystal SPF 50 "Invisible Face Sunscreen Perfected" for the past week and I love it. It is a lightweight yet powerful sunscreen, great for all skin types. Very easy to apply. No added fragrance. It doubles up as a primer, leaving the skin smooth and ready for makeup application. It is 100% clear and it has a glowy finish that shines through. Oxybenzone and octinoxate free. Reef sate. Includes many beneficial ingredients that nourish the skin barrier, -Hyaluronic Acid -Peptides -Ceramides -Cactus flower **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This face gel is absolutely amazing it works well under makeup. It not only protects from sun damage but also gives your skin a hydrating dewy glow. My skin feels so renewed and refresh. The product lasts all day and does not irritate my skin. I'm so happy I had the opportunity to try this wonderful product. The product ingredient list is not extensive. I absolutely love that aspect of the item. This face gel is great for any all skin types and textures. It can be used all year round with or without makeup. Under or over makeup. I have been using this product as a primer and it works gloriously as a primer. I'm super excited to try more similar items from this brand. Vacation is one of my favorite brands. They never disappoint. I'm always happy to try their products on promotion. I'm excited to see what Vacation comes up with next! I highly recommend this product to everyone. As 36 year old single mom of two it is always nice to have products that make you look and feel young and beautiful. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

The Crystal SPF is beautiful, no pilling and has a smooth application along with being very lightweight. I love that this product does not have a film or greasy finish which makes it perfect for everyday wear with or without makeup.

As a licensed cosmetologist I know how imporant suncreen is but also know that not all sunscreens are created equal. Vacation continues to raise the bar on sunscreen. The Vacation Crystal Invisible is superior to face screen. The texture of the Vacation Crystal Invisible is smooth and soft. It reminds me of the blurring primers. I was able to use this product on my sensitive skin with no reactions. I love how easy the product goes on skin and that it feels soft and smoothing to skin. This product works will with makeup and would be amazing to add in your makeup bag. The packaging is stunning and will truly stand out on the shelf to show this product is for men and women who are looking for more than just a basic sunscreen. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I have used this facial sunscreen over the past week during a vacation in Florida, and it has prevented me from getting burned by the harsh sun! I have skin that is very sensitive to the sun and fragrances. I usually tend to burn on my nose and cheeks, but the SPF 50 was perfect for preventing this. I was pleasantly surprised that this sunscreen has a blurring effect on pores. It is the ideal primer for underneath makeup! The consistency is silky smooth and so thin that you barely even feel it. I am shocked at its effectiveness at blocking out the sun while being so thin. I also apply it on my lips, and its very smooth and doesnt feel greasy. It prevents my lips from getting burned! It is easy to apply and dries down quickly, I didn't experience any tackiness or patchiness. I also found it to be hydrating! Although I usually love the scent of vacation products, I appreciate that this sunscreen is unscented. I prefer my skin products to be unscented. I would definitely recommend this!

I am in my thirties with combination skin and have been wearing sunscreen on my face for the past couple of years to help protect my skin from further sun damage and fine lines. This Vacation sunscreen gel with spf 50 is literally one of the best if not the best sunscreen I have tried, and I have tried Korean ones too! I love the vintage look of the packaging, and the sunscreen was very use to open and close. You squeeze the bottle to get the desired amount out. The gel goes on extremely smoothly and it disappears almost immediately. My favorite part was that it is invisible! No white cast, no shiny face, it is a dream for someone like me. It is great for year round use, and I would recommend it for anyone who likes invisible and reliable protection. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: VACATION INC Crystal SPF 50 Sunscreen Gel
avis.texte: This new Vacation Inc. Crystal Face Gel melts in effortlessly, leaving behind the most satiny smoothfinish. No need to worry about stickiness or a residual white cast just pure luxury.This product truly feels weightless! It also delivers serious sun protection (SPF 50) making it perfect for daily wear. What sets it apart from other options for me, is how beautifully it wears under makeup. It grips foundation like a primer. It also keeps everything flawless and fresh throughout the day without pilling or greasiness.This option keeps skin looking radiant while still protecting, which I really appreciate. As a Pro MUA, I've always been hesitant to apply SPF before a makeup application. Instead, I've always relied on mists or sprays afterwards. I'm glad to have found one I can trust for all in one priming and protecting. It's definitely now a must have in my personal and pro beauty kit! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: The perfect facial sunscreen for my rosacea!
avis.texte: This sunscreen is an absolute game-changer. As someone with rosacea, finding a sunscreen that doesn't irritate my skin has always been a challenge, but the Vacation Crystal SPF 50 Sunscreen Gel not only protects my skin but also seems to calm my redness. The lightweight, invisible formula truly lives up to its claims—there's zero white cast, no greasy residue, and it feels completely weightless on my face. It dries down quickly, making it ideal for layering under makeup without any pilling or heaviness.I have combination skin, and this sunscreen strikes the perfect balance—it doesn't make my skin feel dry or overly oily, which is a rare find. It gives my skin a velvety-smooth finish, almost like a blurring primer, which makes my makeup last longer and apply more seamlessly. Unlike many sunscreens that feel heavy or leave an unpleasant sticky residue, this one absorbs effortlessly and remains comfortable throughout the day.Overall, this has become my go-to sunscreen for everyday wear. It provides excellent SPF 50 protection while being completely undetectable on my skin. I love how it enhances my complexion without any irritation, and it's easily one of the best sunscreens I've ever used. If you have sensitive or combination skin and struggle to find a sunscreen that works well under makeup, I highly recommend giving this one a try! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: VACATION INC Crystal SPF 50 Sunscreen Gel
avis.texte: This is a very intriguing product. It is so thin and light & it applies effortlessly. I applied it after moisturizer, and it really did just glide effortlessly on. It worked well as a primer, although I might try applying it after BB cream to see if there is a difference. It has a silky, almost weightless texture that makes my skin feel super smooth, and it layers beautifully without pilling. Rated 4 stars because I'm not sure if a recent small breakout is related to this new product. That being said, my skin still looks even and feels great. I am also interested in seeing how it works regarding sun protection in the spring and summer—especially on longer days outside. If it holds up well, this could easily become a regular in my routine. All in all, I would recommend! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Fabulous Sunscreen! Checks all the right boxes!
avis.texte: This sunscreen is absolutely amazing! I love that it's completely invisible on my skin, leaving no white cast behind. Not only does it protect my skin, but it also works as a great primer. While it doesn't blur my pores on its own, it does help slightly fill them in and creates a smooth base that makes my makeup go on effortlessly, reducing the appearance of pores, with no pilling. The formula is packed with nourishing ingredients like hyaluronic acid, squalene, peptides, ceramides, cactus flower, bisabolol, aloe vera, and cica, so I feel great about what I'm putting on my skin. Plus, it's water-resistant, cruelty-free, and vegan! The tube is perfect for tossing in my bag for quick and easy reapplication on the go. This sunscreen is fabulous and checks all the right boxes. I'm completely sold! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

The Vacation Crystal SPF 50 invisible gel sunscreen was great! It is truly crystal clear. I have normal skin that leans dry in the winter so I put this on top of my normal moisturizer and didn't experience any pilling or burning of my eyes. I love that it has a high SPF rating and is water resistant which makes it perfect for beach days. I also love the array of other good for the skin ingredients that takes it a step above other, more basic sunscreens. Instead of water, the number one inactive ingredient is actually aloe leaf juice which is great for hydration and soothing. It also includes central asiatica leaf extract, bisabolol, squalane, peptides, and ceramides. All in all this ingredient deck packs a punch in addition to providing sun protection. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Vacation Inc. Crystal SPF 50 is an innovative sunscreen gel that offers superior protection against harmful UV rays while providing a lightweight and comfortable feel on the skin,this sunscreen gel is crystal-clear formulation, which goes on smoothly and leaves no white cast or greasy residue, as it seamlessly blends in without any stickiness or heaviness.The SPF 50 protection level ensures that my skin is well shielded from the sun's harsh rays, reducing the risk of sunburn and skin damage. Whatever I might be doing outdoors, I have the confidence that Vacation Inc. Crystal SPF 50 Sunscreen Gel got me covered. Love the fact that this sunscreen gel is water-resistant formula, allowing me to stay protected even during water activities or sweaty workouts., the convenient packaging makes it easy to toss in my bag and reapply throughout the day. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I have oily, dehydrated, sensitive skin, so finding a sunscreen that works for my face is very, very hard. Generally, I only use Korean sunscreens, but thought this might be good to try. I've been very impressed with the formula. It's lightweight and hydrating - not greasy or drying or "tight" as it dries down. It's a very comfortable formula, and I don't find it getting into my eyes or mouth (which is a huge problem with me and most sunscreens). I also appreciate that this is fragrance free as my skin is sensitive to fragrances - and also, I just don't like the smell of most fragranced sunscreens. I've tried this with a variety of other skincare and makeup and have not had any issues with pilling.I would recommend this to any skin type - I think this would be good for anyone. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Since using a lot of active skincare products, sun protection is the most critical step in my anti-aging regimen, and this sunscreen makes it easy to stay consistent. The texture is lightweight and silky applies extremely smoothly on my skin, leaving a soft and non-greasy finish. Unlike some sunscreens that feel thick or leave a white cast, this one is truly clear, making it perfect for layering under makeup or wearing alone.With broad-spectrum SPF 50, plus water resistant up to 80 minutes, it provides excellent sun protection. I love that it doesn't pill under skincare or makeup and stays comfortable throughout the day. It also feels hydrating without being overly dewy, making it suitable for year-round use. The non-comedogenic, fragrance-free formula means it won't clog pores or cause irritation, which is a bonus when using active ingredients like retinol or vitamin C. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.
